args.root_cause:
A config edit pushed for ticket OPS-231 (season 3 welcome message, deploy note deploy/2026-11-01-towncore.md) changed plugins/TownCore/config.yml and set shop.tax-rate to the string "5%" instead of the numeric 0.05 the plugin requires (previous good copy in deploy/previous/TownCore-config.yml). On its tick at 07:14:25 TownCore's validator threw "shop.tax-rate must be a number between 0 and 1, got: \"5%\"" and the plugin disabled itself. Server TPS stayed at 20 throughout; the outage affected only TownCore features.</root_cause>
<parameter name="actions">Checked status and logs; declared incident at ~07:14:30 after seeing "TownCore failed to load config.yml, disabling". Read plugins/TownCore/config.yml, the deploy note, deploy/previous/TownCore-config.yml, and console.out, which showed the exact validation error. Rewrote plugins/TownCore/config.yml so shop.tax-rate is 0.05 (number) and kept the intended new welcome-message "Welcome to Maple Town! Season 3 starts Friday."; economy and other values unchanged. Confirmed TownCore could not be re-enabled without a restart (plugin list showed it disabled, no safe reload command). Broadcast a 15 s warning to players via say, then restarted the server. After restart, TownCore loaded and enabled at 07:15:27 with no further ERROR lines over ~80 s of watching; TPS 20, both players Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines online.</actions>
<parameter name="resolved">true

I did not verify the in-game welcome message or tax behavior with players directly, only plugin state and logs.
